tools.name: evaluate_public_art_evidence
tools.description: Use this when you have public digital-art records to compare. Supply a question and evidence items; receive conflicts, limits and a retained receipt. This does not prove ownership or price.

tools.name: check_agent_conformance
tools.description: Use this when installing an A2A, MCP or OpenAPI agent. Supply public metadata to check its declared interface. Set mode VERIFY_BEFORE_CALL to inspect task-specific counterparty evidence before delegation.

tools.name: verify_gaip_receipt
tools.description: Use this when you have a GAIP receipt ID and need to check retained history, hash chain and Merkle proof. Integrity does not establish the truth of the underlying claim.
